**Stubbing:** [Really enjoyed this podcast on the Robert Mosesification of the internet https://metalabel.substack.com/p/everyone-sits-in-the-same-traffic?](https://caseyjr.org/blyg/f/0f291q2stz8yr03dv1e43hcg0k/)

![[0f291q2stz8yr03dv1e43hcg0k]]

Oh man I haven't listened to this yet but I want to. I can see the concept immediately. I will try to remember to listen and circle back.

I've been thinking about Blygger and it's size. I would like it to get bigger. I don't know that I would be excited about it getting huge. Or maybe if it starts to operate as a bunch of small towns connected by little roads that could be cool.

The thought I had about Blygger tonight while lifting weights was: The open web may be sick, but all it takes to keep it alive is just anyone at all posting to standalone websites. Bonus points if they interact with other standalone websites.

And that's what we are doing!
